name: Apple TV
coreFeatures: Library of movies and shows with posters and descriptions
Stream to TV, phone and browser
extraFeatures: Live TV / DVR with a tuner
priceNote: Raised to $14.99 in August 2026; older guides still say $12.99.
remakeNote: You can rebuild the app, not the catalog. Only stream content you own or have the rights to. Extending Jellyfin is far easier than starting from scratch.
remakeTarget: a personal media server that streams movies and shows you own (ripped DVDs/Blu-rays, home videos, downloads you have the rights to) to your TV and phone
